The Electric DK2 Essential is our base model electric cargo bike, designed to provide you with everything you need to ride—right out of the box. Unlike many cargo bikes that require extra purchases, the Essential comes equipped, so you can hit the road with confidence. Includes: bucket / 2 bench seats / 4 seat belts / integrated rim lock / patented kickstand
Check out our Premium and Luxury Accessory packages, or purchase Accessories separately.
Electric DK2 Specs:

FRAME: Keeping MADSEN's renowned excellent handling and comfort, DK2 features a taller stem and head tube for a more upright ride. A new front fork with a beautiful biplane crown and thru-axle dropouts adds strength, while internal cable routing gives the frame a clean, sleek look.

BRAKES: Jagwire/RIDEREVER CARGO-TE. This hydraulic brake system features a CNC-machined caliper with extra-thick 5mm brake pads and extra-thick rotors 2.3mm. 203mm front rotor, 180mm rear rotor. creating worry-free, long-lasting, superior braking power, specifically designed from the ground up for heavy cargo bikes.

TIRES: New frame makes room for more comfortable, plush, XL tires.

ELECTRIC SYSTEM: Integrated 750-watt Bafang mid-drive motor (500-watt for Canada), powerful 48V 13ah, UL-certified battery with lockable mount, 120 Nm of torque, pedal assist system with 5 power levels, gear sensor for smooth shifting, and LCD display.
